verdict.rationale: Composio documents hosted MCP servers that need no protocol plumbing. You can call composio.mcp.create with selected toolkits and allowed_tools, or set `mcp: true` on a session to get a hosted MCP URL. These servers only expose Composio's own catalog toolkits, though. Nothing in the evidence shows importing your own OpenAPI spec or wrapping custom code; the openapi.json probe is Composio's own API spec, not an import feature. Missing for 10: OpenAPI-to-MCP import, custom-code/custom-tool hosting as MCP, independent corroboration.
